create_sgd_optimizer: create a LocalOptimizerSGD instance for a PyTorch model with configurable learning rate and momentum
create_adam_optimizer: create a LocalOptimizerAdam instance for a PyTorch model with configurable betas and epsilon
create_fedprox_optimizer: create a LocalOptimizerFedProx instance for federated learning with a proximal mu regularization term
get_sgd_dict_config: get an SGD optimizer config dictionary using LocalOptimizerSGD.dict_config with custom lr and momentum
run_fedprox_step: run a FedProx optimization step that applies SGD updates with proximal regularization to the global model
